notes.title: Trailer: DISCOVER THE INCREDIBLE POWER OF THE SMURFIZER IN A BRAND NEW TRAILER!
notes.content:
Microids and IMPS are delighted to introduce more details on the ultimate tool the Smurfs will use to fight back against the Vileaf corrupting their forest! This devilish and very toxic plant created by Gargamel endangers both the flora and our little blue friend! Indeed, the “Viletrap” seeds secreted by the Vileaf lure the Smurfs and keep them captive in organic cages…

[previewyoutube=kpdjuzVt0Co;full][/previewyoutube]

Despite this dreadful situation, hope is not lost! Handy Smurf has THE ideal tool to save the day and you’ll find all the details in this new trailer!


This impressive tool is the incredible Smurfizer, a revolutionary invention including great features like:
[list]
[*] A body made of wood and metal: These materials are well known for their sturdiness! Perfect for a great adventure!
[*] A stable shoulder strap: Super convenient to carry the Smurfizer easily with a complete freedom of movement. 
[*] An ergonomic handle: For a fantastic grip and a precision like no other!
[*] And last but not least, a pollen pump: Great for vaporizing pollen over a long distance!
[/list]

The Smurfizer will allow you to rush, glide, smash, vacuum and shoot out projectiles, but most importantly, vaporize a powerful antidote developed by Papa Smurf to heal the plants infected by the Vileaf and fight various enemies. Once you’ve tried the Smurfizer, you’ll asked yourself how you could ever live without it!

notes.title: THE SMURFS - MISSION VILEAF GETS A TEASER!
notes.content:
Once again, our beloved Smurf friends have to find a way to elude Gargamel’s evil plans!

[previewyoutube=tW22HiWnxA8;full][/previewyoutube]

 In his dark laboratory, the evil wizard Gargamel has discovered a formula allowing him to create a wicked plant, called Vileaf. This plant produces “Viletrap” seeds, which can attract Smurfs and imprison them in vegetal traps! But these Viletrap plants are also a great danger for the forest, as they are highly toxic, especially for the sarsaparilla fields!

For this very important mission, players will take control of an ace Smurf team featuring Hefty, Smurfette, Brainy and Chef! Our heroes can rely upon a very handy tool, the Smurfizer, a revolutionary invention from Handy Smurf. The Smurfizer allows the Smurfs to get rid of the foes they encounter, heal the plants afflicted by the Vileaf, as well as jump higher, glide through the air or dive.

[h2]Game details:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Embark on a brand new journey with a unique and easy to pick up gameplay. The Smurfs – Mission Vileaf will appeal to all gamer profiles, fans of the cute characters, or 3D platformer aficionados, would they be beginners or experienced players.
[*] A one-of-a-kind roster! Take control of 4 emblematic Smurfs: Smurfette, Hefty, Brainy and Chef.
[*] The Smurfizer, a very smurful tool! Your do-it-all Smurfizer will not only allow you to heal the corrupted plants but also facilitate your progression through the game thanks to its multiple functions! Jump higher, glide, dive and overcome all the obstacles you’ll encounter! 
[*] A platform Adventure game with a capital A! Explore each corner of the 5 worlds and find your way through the levels to collect all the ingredients to prepare the antidote the forest desperately needs!
[*] Bring the Smurfs’ village back to life! Find useful items along the way to upgrade your Smurfizer and work towards bringing the Smurf village back to its former glory!
[/list]
